rationale: PINS the implicit library form, which is 96.1% of the corpus (2,882 of 3,000 sampled files): no directive at all, so the Dart spec names the library after the file stem. This is the case where the published stem is a fact rather than a convention, and it is the case that dominates. The fixture also pins that the Module node does not require the file to import anything to exist — it does import one thing, so the reverse case (a library with no imports at all) is what the analyzer's unconditional publication is really claiming, and `dedup-and-attribution` covers the no-directive node existing without directives.
